summary: Iter46: Tagih via WhatsApp (debt reminder) feature tested end-to-end. Backend POST /api/transactions/{id}/reminded persists last_reminder_at/by and increments reminder_count; returns 404 on unknown id; requires auth. Frontend: Tagih button only on unpaid piutang rows (not hutang tab, not lunas), modal prefills phone from tx.telepon, builds message with customer name, invoice no, total, sudah dibayar, Sisa Tagihan; send disabled when phone < 9 digits; send opens wa.me/62... in new tab with encoded (edited) text, closes modal, calls backend reminded endpoint, badge hp-reminded-{id} shows 'Ditagih Nx · terakhir <datetime>' and count increments on repeated sends.

minor.issue: Uses ObjectId(tid) without try/except InvalidId; passing a non-ObjectId string returns 500 instead of 404 (minor; valid-format unknown ids correctly return 404).

action_items: (Optional) Wrap ObjectId(tid) in /transactions/{tid}/reminded with try/except InvalidId to return 404 instead of 500 for malformed ids.
critical_code_review_comments: DebtReminderModal.send() does not await the POST before calling onSent/onClose; onSent runs in .then so list refresh is after success, which is correct, but errors are silently swallowed (.catch(() => {})) — consider toast on failure.
mark_reminded does not validate ObjectId format (potential 500 on bad input).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST-REM-001 and TEST-REM-FE products plus associated credit transactions during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter46 Tagih via WhatsApp verified. Backend test at test_iter46_reminder.py reuses seeded product; cleans up tx. Frontend window.open is called twice when clicking send in dev (once with no args by something — not app code), filter non-null when asserting.
